title: Zong Cheng Fah

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Police.
（印：FOL 5. I. O. REG No. 1000 Date 923/1461）
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
13th March, 1917.
REPORT ON The German Nielsen.
Made by D.S.I.Brewster. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspec...
Sir,
A Boy of the German Club named Zong Cheng Fah (戎錦發) made a statement to me to-day which is rather interesting. He has been employed at the German Club for 10 years and was previously employed on a German Mail Steamer. He states that in September last year he was approached by a Bathshop keeper named Zung Jung Sing (程潤林) living at 700 Fokien Road to purchase a quantity of opium from the notorious German Nielsen who was at that time at No. 103 Chautong Road. He was chosen for the work because he speaks German fairly well. Nielsen said he could sell him any amount of opium against spot cash. The sum of $1900.00 was handed over to Nielsen by the Boy, at 103 Chautong Road but instead of handing over the opium as promised Nielsen told the Boy to call again. On his doing so Nielsen denied having received the money and chased him out, threatening legal proceedings.
Three days afterwards Nielsen was again approached by the Boy and, after some argument, gave him $50. The Boy, not satisfied with this, went to a Lawyer Dr. Fischer (German) who sent for Nielsen after he had received a fee of $100.00 Nielsen denied having received the money but admitted having returned $50.00 which he said was a present for past services. These the matter ended and the Boy states that he had to return the original sum to the Bathshop Keeper and this involved the loss of all his savings. He does not wish to take active proceedings against Nielsen but wishes the Police to know what sort of man he is. He only appeared at the Station on invitation from myself as I thought when I heard of the

（印：FOL 5. I. O. REG No. 1000 Date 923/1461）
中央巡捕房。
1917年3月13日。
关于德国人尼尔森（Nielsen）的报告。
由副探目布鲁斯特（Brewster）撰写。经首席探目转呈……

先生，

德国总会的一名男侍戎錦發（Zong Cheng Fah）今日向我作了一份陈述，内容颇有意思。他在德国总会已受雇十年，此前曾在一艘德国邮船上工作。他称，去年九月，居住在福建路700号的一家浴室店主程潤林（Zung Jung Sing）接洽他，向当时住在兆通路103号的臭名昭著的德国人尼尔森购买大量鸦片。之所以选中他从事此项工作，是因为他的德语说得相当好。尼尔森称，只要支付现金，他可以出售任意数量的鸦片。该男侍在兆通路103号交给尼尔森1900.00元，但尼尔森并未按承诺交付鸦片，而是让该男侍改日再来。当该男侍再次前往时，尼尔森否认收到过这笔钱，并将他赶出，威胁要提起法律诉讼。

三天后，该男侍再次接触尼尔森，经过一番争论，尼尔森给了他50元。该男侍对此并不满意，遂求助于一位律师费希尔博士（Dr. Fischer，德国人）。费希尔博士在收取了100.00元费用后传唤了尼尔森。尼尔森否认收到过那笔钱，但承认退还了50.00元，并称这是对他过去服务的酬谢。此事至此终结。该男侍称，他不得不将原款退还给那位浴室店主，这导致他失去了所有的积蓄。他不想对尼尔森采取积极的法律行动，但希望警方了解此人的为人。他应我之邀才来到巡捕房，因为当我听说这起

    He states that the members of the Club appear to have
very little money and their chits are very small. Those
who previously drank wine now drink beer and even on receipt
of good news from Germany there is now no wine bought whereas
previously large quantities was consumed. The Chinese staff
have been notified that their wages will be reduced from the
✓ 1st of next month. Tips also appear to have been stopped.
Various other questions that I asked the Boy met with the
answer that he did not know and I suspect that he has been
previously cautioned about discussing what goes on in the
Club to anyone other than members. I added that his visit
to the Station was not known to his employer.A

发自
刑事调查处
1917年2月12日。

致
第429号
日期 17/2/16

迈达药房（Mai Tah Dispensary，位于兆通路）经理尼尔森在《新申报》上刊登广告，声明他已将药房的管理权移交给华人，以便从事其他业务，并告知相关方在本报刊登此公告之日起两周内，与他结清今年一月之前由药房订购的货物、欠款及提供的担保事宜。

朱五均（Tsu Oo Chun）在《新申报》上刊登广告，声明他自一月起已接管迈达药房的管理权，他将不对一月之前由药房订购的货物、欠他人的款项及提供的担保承担责任，并称该商号中无外资。

经刑事调查处主任核准。
F. O.
报告。

回复由副探目吉文斯（Givens）发出。

先生，

关于该广告，尼尔森与朱五均自1915年底至约一个月前，在兆通路108号合伙经营化学药品生意，当时尼尔森将其在该商号的股份以规元2,400.00两的价格卖给了朱氏。尼尔森现已切断与该机构的所有联系。

                                您顺从的仆人，
                                D.S.吉文斯
                                副探目
